notes.title: Potions In Motion is Steam Deck verified
notes.content:
I'm happy to let you know that Potions In Motion meets all Steam Deck ✅ Verified criteria.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45206606/759a95f52b2e5cbbb3f9344274a833b8c076cfa6.png[/img]

We continuously test the game on multiple devices, including the Steam Deck, to make sure that all inputs are handled, all text are legible and most importantly that the game is fun to play.

Happy potion making!

Three-Eared Bear

notes.title: Update notes for Nov 2 (v1.0.2.0)
notes.content:
Today's update brings improved symbols matching your input device, let it be a controller, keyboard and mouse, or even a Steam Deck.
